Course Training — official docs, a sprint backlog, a product backlog, and calendar & deliveries — lives on the sister teaching wiki, [albertprofe.dev](https://albertprofe.dev){.external target="_blank"}, under Training Courses (for example the current edition, [IFCD0021-26](https://albertprofe.dev/ifcd0021-26/ifcd0021-26.html){.external target="_blank"}). This section used to be reserved for that same pattern when an AI course was confirmed. There is still no live AI course documented on this wiki, and I will not invent a sprint, a calendar, or a student count here.

Classroom Training labs — numbered work tied to a sprint — and course packs belong on the sister wiki as well. They are not listed in this Books section.
